success_patterns: Reserve `print("No planning needed")` for turns requiring zero tool calls; perform any required refinement or missing-information request instead, and do not append the sentinel after tool work.

patch.reasoning: Both trajectories emitted the no-planning sentinel when a tool action was needed: one appended it after filtering hotels, while the other used it instead of requesting the missing restaurant city. Clarifying that the sentinel means no tool call is required addresses both cases.

edits.target: After the audit, use `print("No planning needed")` only if no requested action or constraint remains unsatisfied by valid cached results.
edits.content: Use this sentinel only when the current execution requires no tool call. If a search, refinement, cache retrieval, nearest-results call, or missing-information request is needed, make that call instead; do not append the sentinel after tool work.
